flow_summary: The interviewer repeatedly failed to recover vague or incomplete answers from the confused patient (e.g., partial name, address, phone format confusion) and instead issued mechanical "repeat in this format" requests or moved on. Questions were mostly one at a time and safety was addressed when raised, but redirection and clarification of disorganised responses were minimal throughout.

Patient gives partial address on Danforth and asks for format guidance; interviewer immediately switches to "What is your Canadian postal code?"
"Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format" and "Please repeat the postal code using letters and numbers" after patient had already supplied the values.
